verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus terminou todas estas palavras, disse aos seus discípulos:
verses.en_web: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,
verses.en_bbe: And when Jesus had come to the end of all these words, he said to his disciples,

verses.en: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
verses.pt: Vós bem sabeis que daqui a dois dias é a Páscoa, e o Filho do homem será entregue para ser crucificado.
verses.en_web: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”
verses.en_bbe: After two days is the Passover, and the Son of man will be given up to the death of the cross.

verses.en: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
verses.pt: Então os chefes dos sacerdotes, os escribas, e os anciãos do povo se reuniram na casa do sumo sacerdote, que se chamava Caifás.
verses.en_web: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.
verses.en_bbe: Then the chief priests and the rulers of the people came together in the house of the high priest, who was named Caiaphas.

verses.en: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
verses.pt: E conversaram a fim de, usando mentira, prenderem Jesus, e o matarem.
verses.en_web: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.
verses.en_bbe: And they made designs together to take Jesus by some trick, and put him to death.

verses.en: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
verses.pt: Porém diziam: Não na festa, para que não haja tumulto entre o povo.
verses.en_web: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”
verses.en_bbe: But they said, Not while the feast is going on, for fear of trouble among the people.

verses.en: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.pt: Enquanto Jesus estava em Betânia, na casa de Simão o leproso,
verses.en_web: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.en_bbe: Now when Jesus was in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper,

verses.en: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
verses.pt: veio a ele uma mulher com um vaso de alabastro, de óleo perfumado de grande valor, e derramou sobre a cabeça dele, enquanto estava sentado à mesa.
verses.en_web: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.
verses.en_bbe: There came to him a woman having a bottle of perfume of great price, and she put the perfume on his head when he was seated at table.

verses.en: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
verses.pt: E quando os seus discípulos viram, ficaram indignados, dizendo: Para que este desperdício?
verses.en_web: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?
verses.en_bbe: But when the disciples saw it they were angry, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

verses.en: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
verses.pt: Pois esse óleo perfumado podia ter sido vendido por muito, e o dinheiro dado aos pobres.
verses.en_web: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.”
verses.en_bbe: For we might have got much money for this and given it to the poor.

verses.en: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
verses.pt: Porém Jesus, sabendo disso,disse-lhes: Por que perturbais a esta mulher? Ora, ela me fez uma boa obra!
verses.en_web: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus, seeing it, said to them, Why are you troubling the woman? she has done a kind act to me.

verses.en: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.pt: Pois vós sempre tendes os pobres convosco, porém nem sempre me tereis.
verses.en_web: For you always have the poor with you; but you don’t always have me.
verses.en_bbe: For the poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.

verses.en: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
verses.pt: Pois ela, ao derramar este óleo perfumado sobre o meu corpo, ela o fez para preparar o meu sepultamento.
verses.en_web: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
verses.en_bbe: For in putting this perfume on my body, she did it to make me ready for my last resting-place.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
verses.pt: Em verdade vos digo que, onde quer que este Evangelho em todo o mundo for pregado, também se dirá o que ela fez, para que seja lembrada.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, Wherever this good news goes out in all the world, what this woman has done will be talked of in memory of her.

verses.en: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
verses.pt: Então um dos doze, chamado Judas Iscariotes, foi aos chefes dos sacerdotes,
verses.en_web: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,
verses.en_bbe: Then one of the twelve, who was named Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests and said,

verses.en: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
verses.pt: e disse: O que quereis me dar, para que eu o entregue a vós? E eles lhe determinaram trinta moedas de prata.
verses.en_web: and said, “What are you willing to give me, that I should deliver him to you?” They weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.
verses.en_bbe: What will you give me, if I give him up to you? And the price was fixed at thirty bits of silver.

verses.en: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.pt: E desde então ele buscava oportunidade para o entregar.
verses.en_web: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.en_bbe: And from that time he was watching for a chance to give him into their hands.

verses.en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
verses.pt: E no primeiro dia da festa dos pães sem fermento, os discípulos vieram a Jesus lhe perguntar: Onde queres que te preparemos para comer a Páscoa?
verses.en_web: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
verses.en_bbe: Now on the first day of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Where are we to make ready for you to take the Passover meal?

verses.en: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
verses.pt: E ele respondeu: Ide à cidade a um tal, e dizei-lhe: “O Mestre diz: ‘Meu tempo está perto. Contigo celebrarei a Páscoa com os meus discípulos’”.
verses.en_web: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Go into the town to such a man, and say to him, The Master says, My time is near: I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.

verses.en: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
verses.pt: Os discípulos fizeram como Jesus havia lhes mandado, e prepararam a Páscoa.
verses.en_web: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.
verses.en_bbe: And the disciples did as Jesus had said to them; and they made ready the Passover.

verses.en: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
verses.pt: E vindo o anoitecer, ele se assentou à mesa com os doze.
verses.en_web: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.
verses.en_bbe: Now when evening was come, he was seated at table with the twelve disciples;

verses.en: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.pt: E enquanto comiam, disse: Em verdade vos digo que um de vós me trairá.
verses.en_web: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
verses.en_bbe: And while they were taking food, he said, Truly I say to you that one of you will be false to me.

verses.en: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
verses.pt: Eles ficaram muito tristes, e cada um deles começou a lhe perguntar: Por acaso sou eu, Senhor?
verses.en_web: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”
verses.en_bbe: And they were very said, and said to him, one by one, Is it I, Lord?

verses.en: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
verses.pt: E ele respondeu: O que mete comigo a mão no prato, esse me trairá.
verses.en_web: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish, the same will betray me.
verses.en_bbe: And he made answer and said, He who puts his hand into the plate with me, the same will be false to me.

verses.en: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
verses.pt: De fato, o Filho do homem vai assim como dele está escrito; mas ai daquele homem por quem o Filho do homem é traído! Bom seria a tal homem se não houvesse nascido.
verses.en_web: The Son of Man goes, even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
verses.en_bbe: The Son of man goes, even as the Writings say of him: but a curse is on that man through whom the Son of man is given up; it would have been well for that man if he had never come into the world.

verses.en: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
verses.pt: E Judas, o que o traía, perguntou: Por acaso sou eu, Rabi? Jesus lhe disse: Tu o disseste.
verses.en_web: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”
verses.en_bbe: And Judas, who was false to him, made answer and said, Is it I, Master? He says to him, Yes.

verses.en: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
verses.pt: E enquanto comiam, Jesus tomou o pão, abençoou-o, e o partiu. Então o deu aos discípulos, e disse: Tomai, comei; isto é o meu corpo.
verses.en_web: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples, and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”
verses.en_bbe: And when they were taking food, Jesus took bread and, after blessing it, he gave the broken bread to the disciples and said, Take it; this is my body.

verses.en: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
verses.pt: Em seguida tomou o cálice, deu graças, e o deu a eles, dizendo: Bebei dele todos,
verses.en_web: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,
verses.en_bbe: And he took a cup and, having given praise, he gave it to them, saying,

verses.en: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.pt: porque este é o meu sangue, o sangue do novo testamento, o qual é derramado por muitos, para o perdão de pecados.
verses.en_web: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.
verses.en_bbe: Take of it, all of you, for this is my blood of the testament, which is given for men for the forgiveness of sins.

verses.en: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.
verses.pt: E eu vos digo que desde agora não beberei deste fruto da vide, até aquele dia, quando convosco o beber, novo, no reino do meu Pai.
verses.en_web: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”
verses.en_bbe: But I say to you that from now I will not take of this fruit of the vine, till that day when I take it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

verses.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.pt: E depois de cantarem um hino, saíram para o monte das Oliveiras.
verses.en_web: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.en_bbe: And after a song of praise to God, they went out to the Mountain of Olives.

verses.en: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.pt: Então Jesus lhes disse: Todos vós falhareis comigo esta noite; porque está escrito: “Ferirei o pastor, e as ovelhas do rebanho serão dispersas”.
verses.en_web: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
verses.en_bbe: Then said Jesus to them, All of you will be turned away from me this night: for it is said in the Writings, I will put to death the keeper of the sheep, and the sheep of the flock will be put to flight.

verses.en: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.pt: Mas, depois que eu for ressuscitado, irei adiante de vós para a Galileia.
verses.en_web: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
verses.en_bbe: But after I am come back from the dead, I will go before you into Galilee.

verses.en: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
verses.pt: Pedro, porém, respondeu-lhe: Ainda que todos falhem contigo, eu nunca falharei.
verses.en_web: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
verses.en_bbe: But Peter made answer and said to him, Though all may be turned away from you, I will never be turned away.

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.pt: Jesus lhe disse: Em verdade te digo que, nesta mesma noite, antes do galo cantar, tu me negarás três vezes.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to him, Truly I say to you that this night, before the hour of the cock's cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me.

verses.en: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.pt: Pedro lhe respondeu: Ainda que eu tenha de morrer contigo, em nenhuma maneira te negarei. E todos os discípulos disseram o mesmo.
verses.en_web: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.
verses.en_bbe: Peter says to him, Even if I am put to death with you, I will not be false to you. So said all the disciples.

verses.en: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
verses.pt: Então Jesus veio com eles a um lugar chamado Getsêmani, e disse aos discípulos: Ficai sentados aqui, enquanto eu vou ali orar.
verses.en_web: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”
verses.en_bbe: Then comes Jesus with them to a place named Gethsemane, and says to his disciples, Be seated here, while I go over there for prayer.

verses.en: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
verses.pt: Enquanto trazia consigo Pedro e os dois filhos de Zebedeu, ele começou a se entristecer e a se angustiar muito.
verses.en_web: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
verses.en_bbe: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and became sad and very troubled.

verses.en: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
verses.pt: Então lhes disse: Minha alma está completamente triste até a morte. Ficai aqui, e vigiai comigo.
verses.en_web: Then he said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.”
verses.en_bbe: Then says he to them, My soul is very sad, even to death: keep watch with me here.

verses.en: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
verses.pt: E indo um pouco mais adiante, prostrou-se sobre o seu rosto, orando, e dizendo: Meu Pai, se é possível, passe de mim este cálice; porém, não seja como eu quero, mas sim como tu queres.
verses.en_web: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
verses.en_bbe: And he went forward a little, and falling down on his face in prayer, he said, O my Father, if it is possible, let this cup go from me; but let not my pleasure, but yours be done.

verses.en: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
verses.pt: Então voltou aos seus discípulos, e os encontrou dormindo; e disse a Pedro: Então, nem sequer uma hora pudestes vigiar comigo?
verses.en_web: He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
verses.en_bbe: And he comes to the disciples, and sees that they are sleeping, and says to Peter, What, were you not able to keep watch with me one hour?

verses.en: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verses.pt: Vigiai e orai, para que não entreis em tentação. De fato, o espírito está pronto, mas a carne é fraca.
verses.en_web: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
verses.en_bbe: Keep watch with prayer, so that you may not be put to the test: the spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is feeble.

verses.en: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
verses.pt: Ele foi orar pela segunda vez, dizendo: Meu Pai, se este cálice não pode passar de mim sem que eu o beba, faça-se a tua vontade.
verses.en_web: Again, a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”
verses.en_bbe: Again, a second time he went away, and said in prayer, O my Father, if this may not go from me without my taking it, let your pleasure be done.

verses.en: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
verses.pt: Quando voltou, achou-os outra vez dormindo, pois os seus olhos estavam pesados.
verses.en_web: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
verses.en_bbe: And he came again and saw them sleeping, for their eyes were tired.

verses.en: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.pt: Então os deixou, e foi orar pela terceira vez, dizendo as mesmas palavras.
verses.en_web: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
verses.en_bbe: And he went away from them again, and a third time said the same prayer.

verses.en: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.pt: Depois veio aos seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Agora dormi e descansai. Eis que chegou a hora em que o Filho do homem é entregue em mãos de pecadores.
verses.en_web: Then he came to his disciples, and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.en_bbe: Then he comes to the disciples; and says to them, Go on sleeping now, and take your rest: for the hour is come, and the Son of man is given into the hands of evil men.

verses.en: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
verses.pt: Levantai-vos, vamos! Eis que chegou o que me trai.
verses.en_web: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
verses.en_bbe: Up, let us be going: see, he who gives me up is near.

verses.en: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.pt: Enquanto ele ainda estava falando, eis que veio Judas, um dos doze, e com ele uma grande multidão, com espadas e bastões, da parte dos chefes dos sacerdotes e dos anciãos do povo.
verses.en_web: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.en_bbe: And while he was still talking, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a band armed with swords and sticks, from the chief priests and those in authority over the people.

verses.en: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
verses.pt: O seu traidor havia lhes dado sinal, dizendo: Aquele a quem eu beijar, é esse. Prendei-o.
verses.en_web: Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
verses.en_bbe: Now the false one had given them a sign saying, The one to whom I give a kiss, that is he: take him.

verses.en: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
verses.pt: Logo ele se aproximou de Jesus, e disse: Felicitações, Rabi! e o beijou.
verses.en_web: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Hail, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away he came to Jesus and said, Master! and gave him a kiss.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
verses.pt: Jesus, porém, lhe perguntou: Amigo, para que vieste? Então chegaram, agarraram Jesus, e o prenderam.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to him, Friend, do that for which you have come. Then they came and put hands on Jesus, and took him.

verses.en: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.
verses.pt: E eis que um dos que estavam com Jesus estendeu a mão, puxou de sua espada, e feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote, cortando-lhe uma orelha.
verses.en_web: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.
verses.en_bbe: And one of those who were with Jesus put out his hand, and took out his sword and gave the servant of the high priest a blow, cutting off his ear.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
verses.pt: Jesus, então, lhe disse: Põe de volta tua espada ao seu lugar, pois todos os que pegarem espada, pela espada perecerão.
verses.en_web: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.
verses.en_bbe: Then says Jesus to him, Put up your sword again into its place: for all those who take the sword will come to death by the sword.

verses.en: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.pt: Ou, por acaso, pensas tu que eu não posso agora orar ao meu Pai, e ele me daria mais de doze legiões de anjos?
verses.en_web: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.en_bbe: Does it not seem possible to you that if I make request to my Father he will even now send me an army of angels?

verses.en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
verses.pt: Como, pois, se cumpririam as Escrituras que dizem que assim tem que ser feito?
verses.en_web: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”
verses.en_bbe: But how then would the Writings come true, which say that so it has to be?

verses.en: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
verses.pt: Naquela hora Jesus disse às multidões: Como a um ladrão saístes com espadas e bastões para me prender? Todo dia eu me sentava convosco, ensinando no templo, e não me prendestes.
verses.en_web: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.
verses.en_bbe: In that hour Jesus said to the people, Have you come out as against a thief with swords and sticks to take me? I was teaching every day in the Temple and you took me not.

verses.en: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
verses.pt: Porém tudo isto aconteceu para que as Escrituras dos profetas se cumpram.Então todos os discípulos o abandonaram, e fugiram.
verses.en_web: But all this has happened, that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him, and fled.
verses.en_bbe: But all this has taken place so that the writings of the prophets might come true. Then all his disciples went from him in flight.

verses.en: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
verses.pt: Os que prenderam Jesus o trouxeram à casa de Caifás, o sumo sacerdote, onde os escribas e os anciãos estavam reunidos.
verses.en_web: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
verses.en_bbe: And those who had made Jesus prisoner took him away to the house of Caiaphas, the high priest, where the scribes and those in authority over the people had come together.

verses.en: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
verses.pt: E Pedro o seguia de longe, até o pátio do sumo sacerdote; e entrou, e se assentou com os servos, para ver o fim.
verses.en_web: But Peter followed him from a distance, to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.
verses.en_bbe: But Peter went after him at a distance, to the house of the high priest, and went in and took his seat with the servants, to see the end.

verses.en: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
verses.pt: Os chefes dos sacerdotes, os anciãos, e todo o supremo conselho buscavam falso testemunho contra Jesus, para poderem matá-lo,
verses.en_web: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death;
verses.en_bbe: Now the chief priests and all the Sanhedrin were looking for false witness against Jesus, so that they might put him to death;

verses.en: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
verses.pt: mas não encontravam. E ainda que muitas falsas testemunhas se apresentavam, contudo não encontravam.
verses.en_web: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward,
verses.en_bbe: And they were not able to get it, though a number of false witnesses came.

verses.en: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
verses.pt: Mas, por fim, vieram duas falsas testemunhas, que disseram: Este disse: “Posso derrubar o Templo de Deus e reconstruí-lo em três dias”.
verses.en_web: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”
verses.en_bbe: But later there came two who said, This man said, I am able to give the Temple of God to destruction, and to put it up again in three days.

verses.en: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.pt: Então o sumo sacerdote se levantou, e lhe perguntou: Não respondes nada ao que eles testemunham contra ti?
verses.en_web: The high priest stood up, and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
verses.en_bbe: And the high priest got up and said to him, Have you no answer? what is it which these say against you?

verses.en: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
verses.pt: Porém Jesus ficava calado. Então o sumo sacerdote lhe disse: Ordeno-te pelo Deus vivo que nos digas se tu és o Cristo, o Filho de Deus.
verses.en_web: But Jesus held his peace. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God, that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus said not a word. And the high priest said to him, I put you on oath, by the living God, that you will say to us if you are the Christ, the Son of God.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.pt: Jesus lhe disse: Tu o disseste. Porém eu vos digo que, desde agora, vereis o Filho do homem, sentado à direita do Poderoso, e vindo sobre as nuvens do céu.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “You have said it. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus says to him, You say so: but I say to you, From now you will see the Son of man seated at the right hand of power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.

verses.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
verses.pt: Então o sumo sacerdote rasgou suas roupas, e disse: Ele blasfemou! Para que necessitamos mais de testemunhas? Eis que agora ouvistes a sua blasfêmia.
verses.en_web: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
verses.en_bbe: Then the high priest, violently parting his robes, said, He has said evil against God: what more need have we of witnesses? for now his words against God have come to your ears:

verses.en: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
verses.pt: Que vos parece?E eles responderam: Culpado de morte ele é.
verses.en_web: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
verses.en_bbe: What is your opinion? They made answer and said, It is right for him to be put to death.

verses.en: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
verses.pt: Então lhe cuspiram no rosto, e lhe deram socos.
verses.en_web: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
verses.en_bbe: Then they put shame on him, and were cruel to him: and some gave him blows, saying,

verses.en: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
verses.pt: Outros lhe deram bofetadas, e diziam: Profetiza-nos, ó Cristo, quem é o que te feriu?
verses.en_web: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
verses.en_bbe: Be a prophet, O Christ, and say who gave you a blow!

verses.en: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
verses.pt: Pedro estava sentado fora no pátio. Uma serva aproximou-se dele, e disse: Também tu estavas com Jesus, o galileu.
verses.en_web: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
verses.en_bbe: Now Peter was seated in the open square outside the house: and a servant-girl came to him, saying, You were with Jesus the Galilaean.

verses.en: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
verses.pt: Mas ele o negou diante de todos, dizendo: Não sei o que dizes.
verses.en_web: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
verses.en_bbe: But he said before them all that it was false, saying, I have no knowledge of what you say.

verses.en: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.pt: E quando ele saiu em direção à entrada, outra o viu, e disse aos que ali estavam: Também este estava com Jesus, o nazareno.
verses.en_web: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him, and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
verses.en_bbe: And when he had gone out into the doorway, another saw him and says to those who were there, This man was with Jesus the Nazarene.

verses.en: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
verses.pt: E ele o negou outra vez com um juramento: Não conheço esse homem.
verses.en_web: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”
verses.en_bbe: And again he said with an oath, I have no knowledge of the man.

verses.en: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
verses.pt: Pouco depois, os que ali estavam se aproximaram, e disseram a Pedro: Verdadeiramente também tu és um deles, pois a tua fala te denuncia.
verses.en_web: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”
verses.en_bbe: And after a little time those who were near came and said to Peter, Truly you are one of them; because your talk is witness against you.

verses.en: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
verses.pt: Então ele começou a amaldiçoar e a jurar: Não conheço esse homem!E imediatamente o galo cantou.
verses.en_web: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
verses.en_bbe: Then with curses and oaths he said, I have no knowledge of the man. And straight away there came the cry of a cock.

verses.en: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.pt: Então Pedro se lembrou da palavra de Jesus, que lhe dissera: Antes do galo cantar, tu me negarás três vezes. Assim ele saiu, e chorou amargamente.
verses.en_web: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” He went out and wept bitterly.
verses.en_bbe: And the word of Jesus came back to Peter, when he said, Before the hour of the cock's cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me. And he went out, weeping bitterly.
